meta.supersedes: Model U (v1.0.0) — retired 2026-08-06 per Shayan's explicit direction to adopt the design-request reference palette (docs/superpowers/mockups/tapcash-mockup-v6). Model U itself was never formally approved (REDESIGN_SPEC.md §8.1 listed it as an open decision for Shayan, not a locked one) — this is the first palette decision either has actually confirmed.
decisionLog: 2026-08-06: Shayan confirmed the glow/neon treatment (hero glow, active-state glow, floating art) — this explicitly overrides REDESIGN_SPEC.md's 'No ambient glow on static elements' anti-pattern for INTERACTIVE and hero elements. Glow stays disallowed on purely static, non-hierarchical decoration.

2026-08-06: Shayan confirmed 'No fabricated statistics' and 'No fake live-activity rows' STAY IN FORCE — the design-request mockup's stats strip and live-user pill must be either wired to real /api/stats/platform data or removed, not shipped as round marketing-style placeholders.

2026-08-06 (RETRACTED same day, after seeing the v6 mockup built on this palette): 'get rid of the neon vibe' + 'still shows generic AI template' + 'needs to be premium/high-end/custom, not neon-gamer'. The #14F195 neon-green primitives below are NOT the final palette — a new direction is being scoped (see docs/superpowers/mockups/track2-mockup-notes.md v7 notes). Do not build against this palette until re-confirmed. Card/box-based layout (panel-glass, offer-card, etc. patterns) is also rejected — Shayan explicitly dislikes bounded cards/edges, including the box around the hero art image.
antiPatterns: No fabricated statistics — live data from /api/stats/platform or the surface doesn't render
Glow reserved for interactive/hero elements tied to state or hierarchy — no ambient looping glow on purely static decoration

legacy.note: Retired palettes: Model U (v1, 2026-08-05) and the original legacy palette (pre-audit). Any occurrence in platform outputs fails the drift test.
